subject.title: refactor(sessions): move parent-session forking behind the accessor boundary

question: Should maintainers land this parent-fork accessor-boundary slice as a standalone step before the broader SQLite storage flip?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-proven, but it changes session-state ownership and is protected by the maintainer/session-state review surface.

options.title: Land after exact-head checks
options.body: Accept the standalone seam refactor once queued checks on c8a22142cd19cff822ad65dd90d74188c925df08 finish and the session-state proof is accepted.

options.title: Fold into SQLite flip
options.body: Pause this PR and carry the same parent-fork boundary movement in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98236 if maintainers want one storage-flip review lane.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Accept the standalone seam refactor once queued checks on c8a22142cd19cff822ad65dd90d74188c925df08 finish and the session-state proof is accepted.
